foreign_execution.change: The argument bundle names another execution. The real Critic rejects the input (BUNDLE-EXEC).

unknown_node.change: A model-proposed finding was added by hand to the saved report of the rejected-candidates example. It names a node that does not exist.

nonadmitted_assessment.change: A model-proposed finding was added by hand to the same saved report. It cites a checker assessment that is not admitted.

malformed_history.change: Round 2 of the cycle example with a history item that does not chain to this round.

report_schema_invalid.change: The Critic report of the actionable example without its review_status field.
